summary: Daily sliding-tile puzzle on a map of Anatolia for GitHub Game Off 2026 (SHIFT): shift rows and columns to bring rivers and roads to villages while a quake moves one row after every move · Anadolu haritasında günlük kaydırma bulmacası: satır ve sütunları kaydırıp köylere nehir ve yol götür, her hamleden sonra bir deprem bir satırı kaydırır
key_features: Rows and columns wrap around and slide past fixed villages, mountains, the spring and the caravanserai; after each move a seeded quake shifts one row, telegraphed one move ahead
Daily puzzle with the same map for everyone (date seed), endless levels, par and 3 stars, undo, restart, spoiler-free share text, English and Turkish
Generator scrambles a solved board with reverse moves and reverse quakes, so a short solution always exists; an optimal solver (bot A) sets par, a greedy beam search (bot B) plays by feel
Measured: both bots solved 12/12 seeds in Chrome (?auto) and 40/40 puzzles in Node; bot A averages 4.25 moves (= par), bot B 6.5; 60 fps desktop and phone in headless Chrome
One index.html, no assets or external requests; URL flags ?seed, ?demo=1|a|b, ?auto, ?debug for video capture

social.headline: Shift the land of Anatolia: bring water and roads to every village before the next quake · Anadolu toprağını kaydır: bir sonraki depremden önce her köye su ve yol götür

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README and index.html; no field is generated from a guess
